prompt_record.text:
Image1 is the accepted illustration STYLE anchor; image2 is the accepted original adult explorer CHARACTER canon. Create a workflow-sheet conceptual vignette matching image1's quiet hand-drawn editorial style, graphite outlines, soft ivory fills and faint paper grain, muted rose/cyan accents, restrained amber light and warm-grey background.
Show three equal standing view frames side by side: the SAME adult explorer from image2, waist-up front, side and rear views. Retain her short asymmetric dark-teal bob, one silver streak at her left temple, olive high-collar field jacket; the front face has amber eyes and a small scar through her left eyebrow. Render the small figures as simplified anime illustrations inside the frames, with one consistent design and adult proportions. This is illustrative source artwork, not evidence of tested model consistency. No ratings or success symbols.
4:3 landscape, all three frames compact and centred slightly above the middle, quiet empty bottom third for an HTML caption. No writing, labels, letters, numbers, logos, watermark or UI.

art_review.notes: Front, side and rear explorer views strongly resemble the accepted character canon, but the three panels are flat portrait boxes rather than the requested standing frames.
observations: The flat layout loses the raised three-quarter tabletop/frame treatment that unifies the workflow family. Standing-frame refinement is recommended.
Dark-teal asymmetric bob, silver temple streak, olive high collar and amber eyes are visible. The front eyebrow scar is tiny at 600x450 and should not be claimed as clearly resolved in the thumbnail.
The views are bust/upper-torso portraits rather than a clearly visible waist-up study. The front is slightly turned rather than strictly orthographic.
The three views are illustrative source artwork, not evidence of tested character consistency. No labels, ratings or success marks were observed.
Candidate 2 resolves the material refinement issue and is recommended instead. Candidate 1 is retained unchanged for traceability.
